author: amankelttu
body:
#### PR description:
in DQMOffline/JetMET/python/metDQMConfig_cfi.py 
Replaced improperly spelled JetCorrections with the correct spelling ( was missing L1Fast) for PuppiMet

In Validation/RRecoJets/python/JetValidation_cfi.py
Removed unused objects that have been unused since 2019
added JetAnalyzerAk4PFPUPPI for RECO level validations of Phase 2 detectors

In Validation/RRecoJets/python/JetValidation_cff.py
Added JetAnalyzerAk4PFPUPPI into Sequence # fixed the spelling error

Modifed recoJetPtThreshold from 40->20 GeV for synchronization between both JME DQM and BTV in preparation for phase 2 implementations, JME DQM set the standard at 20 GeV, and both BTV and JME Validation are lowering threshold down to 20 GeV

Modifications to JetValidation* were done to improve Validation methods when heading towards phase 2, adding the Puppi method which is the optimal jet choice for Run3/run4 analysis methods/

In Validation/RecoJets/plugins/JetTester.cc
Modified Eta range from (-6 to 6) to (-5 to 5) 
Modified Pt range from (50 bins, 0 GeV, 500 GeV) to (700 bins, 0 GeV, 7000 GeV)
both changes are for syncing with DQM and BTV for Phase 2 changes.
modified Jet mass and dijet mass(mjj) to be 0-7000 GeV with 2/5 GeV bin widths in anticipation of Phase 2 changes

In Validation/RecoJets/plugins/JetTester.h
Modified Eta range to match jettester.cc

Range shifts in Eta are changed to match JME DQM of -5-5 as part of the preparation of Phase 2 upgrade changes
Additionally, pt/energy/mass range changes are implemented to provide a better look at the whole spectrum instead of limiting the regions to only the lower values.  

#### PR validation:

No tests have been run
